cc_compat_description: Claude models only. Preserve complete tool JSON Schemas and encode configured client-brand terms in system instructions with a zero-width separator. Keep all instructions and tools. Turn off to use the original request projection.
cc_compat_terms_description: One literal ASCII term per line, matched without case sensitivity. Only system instructions are affected; user messages and tool arguments stay unchanged. Leave empty for schema repair only.
